d:
The Lakers defeated the Kings, 116-103 tonight in Sacramento. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 40 points along with 9 rebounds and 7 assists for the Lakers, while Austin Reaves tallied 21 points, 4 assists and 3 rebounds in the game. Darius Acuff Jr. recorded 22 points, 12 assists and 3 rebounds. The Lakers improve their record to 7-2 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-7 for the season.
